sessions.phase_label: Application modernization, localization, optimization, design remediation, and validation

requirements.title: Android Platform Modernization
requirements.definition: Modernize the Android code, dependencies, target SDK, deprecated APIs, and obsolete UI infrastructure for current Android compatibility and maintainability.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Android framework, dependency, API, and obsolete-library modernization; Android permissions, localization, and package-size behavior remain independent Requirements.

requirements.title: iOS Platform Modernization
requirements.definition: Modernize the iOS code and framework usage for current iOS compatibility, including replacement of removed or deprecated APIs such as UIWebView.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers iOS runtime and API modernization; the Privacy Manifest, signing configuration, localization, and binary-size optimization are independently actionable Requirements.

requirements.title: iOS Privacy Manifest
requirements.definition: Provide the Privacy Manifest required for current Apple App Store eligibility.
requirements.boundary_note: The manifest is an independently required release artifact rather than an attribute of API modernization or signing.

requirements.title: Valid iOS Signing Configuration
requirements.definition: Maintain valid iOS signing certificates and configuration so the application can be built and submitted through Apple distribution channels.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the validity of release signing configuration, not credential transfer or secret-handling activity.

requirements.title: Android Permission Hygiene
requirements.definition: Remove unjustified Android permissions, including unused sensitive phone-state and storage permissions, to avoid store-review and regional compliance problems.
requirements.boundary_note: Permission declarations can be remediated independently from deprecated API modernization and general dead-code cleanup.

requirements.title: Android Full-App Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the full Android application and keep its string resources complete and synchronized across all 77 selected Google Play languages.
requirements.boundary_note: Android language coverage and string completeness can fail independently from iOS localization; RTL layout, FAQ localization, social-link localization, and How-To media presentation remain separate.

requirements.title: iOS Full-App Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the full iOS application using populated translation resources for the approximately 40 selected App Store languages.
requirements.boundary_note: iOS translation-resource behavior is independently implementable and testable from Android localization; specialized localized content and RTL layout remain separate.

requirements.title: Right-to-Left Layout Support
requirements.definition: Render the application correctly in right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.
requirements.boundary_note: RTL layout behavior can fail even when translated strings are present, so it remains separate from Android and iOS translation coverage.

requirements.title: Functional Social Media Links
requirements.definition: Ensure the social-media links exposed by the application resolve correctly rather than being broken.
requirements.boundary_note: Link reachability is independently testable from whether each locale receives the appropriate social-media link.

requirements.title: Localized Social Media Links
requirements.definition: Provide locale-appropriate social-media links throughout the application.
requirements.boundary_note: Localization of link targets can change independently from link reachability and from ordinary interface-string translation.

requirements.title: Android Application Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Minimize the Android application download footprint through appropriate packaging, shrinking, and asset optimization.
requirements.boundary_note: Android size has a distinct build path and runtime verification from iOS size; App Bundle, shrinking, and asset reduction are techniques or attributes of this optimization mechanism.

requirements.title: iOS Application Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Minimize the iOS application download footprint through thinning, duplicate-asset removal, and related binary optimization.
requirements.boundary_note: iOS size optimization uses an independent binary and delivery path from Android and may be completed or verified separately.

requirements.title: Legacy Youku Video Integration
requirements.definition: The historical Android integration for Chinese video playback through Youku, which can be independently retained or removed.
requirements.boundary_note: This legacy provider-specific integration was explicitly removed and is distinct from the later shared YouTube-based How-To content.

requirements.title: Magnifier Ruler Tracking
requirements.definition: Position the magnifier over the ruler and make it follow the ruler's path correctly.
requirements.boundary_note: Magnifier positioning and movement are independently testable behaviors, separate from number alignment, label clipping, and general skin artwork cleanup.

requirements.title: Measurement Number Alignment
requirements.definition: Display the measurement numbers in their proper aligned positions on the meter interface.
requirements.boundary_note: Numeric alignment has its own visual acceptance criterion and can be corrected independently from magnifier motion or text clipping.

requirements.title: Scoliometer Label Visibility
requirements.definition: Render the Scoliometer label without clipping.
requirements.boundary_note: Label clipping is an independently observable layout defect rather than an attribute of magnifier tracking or numeric alignment.

requirements.title: Application Skin Graphics Cleanup
requirements.definition: Clean up and correct the visual design of the application's skins and associated graphics across the supported mobile versions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers broader multi-skin artwork cleanup while excluding the separately specified magnifier, number-alignment, label-clipping, and iPad-layout behaviors.

requirements.title: iPad Layout Cleanup
requirements.definition: Correct the poorly rendered or unfinished application design on iPad.
requirements.boundary_note: The iPad-specific layout can fail and be remediated independently from phone skins and the individual meter-interface defects.

requirements.title: FAQ Availability
requirements.definition: Include the FAQ feature in both the iOS and Android applications.
requirements.boundary_note: FAQ presence can be implemented or removed independently from whether its content is localized through app strings.

requirements.title: FAQ Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the FAQ through application string resources on both iOS and Android.
requirements.boundary_note: FAQ string localization has an independent acceptance criterion from merely including the FAQ and from translating the pre-existing application interface.

requirements.title: How-To Media Delivery
requirements.definition: Provide the application's How-To Use guidance using the client-approved measurement instructions and the selected shared media-delivery approach across iOS and Android.
requirements.boundary_note: Reusable tutorial images, text overlays, replacement by one shared video, instructional sequence, hosting choice, and media accessibility are evolving attributes of one How-To delivery mechanism; the unrelated legacy Youku integration remains separate.

requirements.title: How-To Measurement Instructions
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer repeatedly asks whether users need an in-app language selector, but the client never confirms or rejects this independently implementable behavior.
A single shared streamed How-To video is selected, but the supplied evidence does not clearly resolve whether the video itself requires localized audio, captions, or language-specific variants.

value_updates.platform_compatibility: modernize Android OS and framework support
value_updates.maintainability: use modern, maintainable Android implementation practices

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Having completed a careful review of both Android and iOS source-code projects, I’ve organized the findings around the work required.

**Submission Assessment**

Both apps work; however, neither can currently be submitted to its store without fixes.

**Findings by Remediation Workstream**

1\. Repair localization and language behavior:
\* For iOS, the project has 34 language folders but no translation files inside them, so the app runs only in English regardless of the phone’s language setting. I would rebuild that translation system.
\* Synchronize the Android language files, since some languages are missing 61 strings.
\* Redesign the tutorial images so additional languages do not require new graphic-design updates each time.

2\. Restore store eligibility:
\* The iOS app uses UIWebView, which Apple removed, so Apple will reject it on submission. The Privacy Manifest required by Apple since May 2024 is also missing, and the signing certificates expired in 2021.
\* The supplied source omits Info.plist and the main ViewController.m file; I need both before beginning iOS work.
\* The fixes are to replace UIWebView on iOS, supply the required Privacy Manifest, and renew the certificates.
\* On Android, remove the unused dangerous permission. The app requests READ\_PHONE\_STATE even though it does not use that sensitive permission, which may create regional review problems with Google Play.

3\. Modernize outdated code and video playback:
\* On modern Android, the code still uses one removed sensor API and several other deprecated calls. The Chinese video integration through Youku also fails because of an HTTP/HTTPS compatibility issue.
\* The libraries are very old and remain 14+ versions behind current releases.
\* I would upgrade the dependencies, replace deprecated APIs, and modernize the YouTube player implementation.

4\. Reduce package size:
\* The Android build is 126 MB, which is much larger than necessary, and it currently has no Android App Bundle, code shrinking, or image optimization.
\* Move Android to the App Bundle format, enable code shrinking, and remove duplicate and unused images.
\* On iOS alone, I identified approximately 28 MB of duplicate files.

5\. Add right-to-left behavior if those languages remain in scope:
\* Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian do not currently behave correctly in RTL, but correct support can be added if needed.

6\. Adopt current platform requirements:
\* Target Android 35, which Google will require soon.
\* Set the minimum target to iOS 15+.

**Unresolved Inputs Needed for Scheduling**

1\. The iOS source appears incomplete because Info.plist and ViewController.m are missing. Do you have the complete project?
2\. The keystore password for the Android signing key was not included with the files. Is it available?
3\. Should the Chinese video from Youku remain, or may it be removed?
4\. For additional languages, should localization cover the full app or only the translated store-listing pages?

Once the missing-source, signing, video, and localization questions are resolved, I can provide a detailed plan with an exact implementation timeline.

execution.observed_behavior: Source-code review found that the Android app still used a removed sensor API, several deprecated calls, and libraries more than 14 versions behind current releases.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
A working APK is ready from each of the 5 phases of the Android cleanup that I've finished, and I can share them with you anytime.

Here's what's complete:

1\. Repo cleanup — from the GitHub repo, I removed 412 MB of leftover build files that had been polluting it
2\. Unused permissions and code — READ\_PHONE\_STATE was removed because it had been triggering Play Store warnings in some countries; I also removed unused storage permissions and dead ad code
3\. Chinese/Youku video — fully removed, as discussed
4\. Deprecated code — the measurement and splash screens now use modern Android APIs
5\. Abandoned UI library — 3,800 lines of old ViewFlow code, last updated ~2017, were replaced with Android ViewPager2

source_message.text:
To take the measurement, complete the numbered sequence below.

1) Bend
The person should bend forward at the waist while keeping their arms hanging down and their palms together.

2) Align
The spine must be centered in the middle notch of a phone held horizontally across the upper back.

3) Measure
Move the phone slowly up the spine. As the phone follows the curve, it will tilt sideways; the measured degree is the highest number displayed during this movement.

Reference: <https://video.cedar-meadow.example/watch/e0023>
